title: Colour Lab
caption: Red, green and blue lamps; cyan, magenta and yellow shadows
blurb: Three lamps shine on a white screen: it is white where all three land, and every object casts three shadows, each the colour of the two lamps that still reach it. Nothing is painted. The colours, and the shadow edges that soften as a lamp grows, come from tracing three lights.

controls.does: switch the red, green and blue lamps
changes the size of the lamps: small is sharp, large is soft
moves the lamps together or apart
turns it, and its three shadows
